# portfolio-web — full context for LLMs

## Identity

Personal portfolio for Dinesh K N. Production: https://www.dineshkn.site. Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind 3, minimal portfolio shell.

## Agent entrypoints

1. AGENTS.md — operational instructions (commands, boundaries)
2. docs/AGENTS-REFERENCE.md — deep dive
3. .cursor/rules/*.mdc — Cursor scoped rules

## Shell architecture

RootLayout -> PortfolioShell -> ShellProvider -> SiteNav -> main -> PageTransition -> page content.

State: reduced-motion and mobile capability gates.

## Routes and content

| Path | Content file | Notes |
|------|----------------|-------|
| / | app/home/HomeContent.js | Hero, proof panel, featured work |
| /skills | app/skills/SkillsContent.js | Bento grid + inspect panel |
| /about | app/about/AboutContent.js | 3-col timeline bridge, viewport locked |
| /projects | app/projects/ProjectsContent.js | Strip + stage, viewport locked |
| /contact | app/contact/ContactContent.js | Formspree POST |

All module pages use components/shell/ModulePage.js. Data: lib/site-content.js.

## Performance defaults

- Minimal shell; no WebGL, boot screen, custom cursor, or audio effects
- Paint-only CSS transitions for interaction feedback; no transform/filter/opacity fades
- Fonts: Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono
- npm run perf:full → perf-reports/latest.json

## Commands

npm install | dev | build | start | lint | perf | perf:full | dev:perf

## Do not

Commit without ask; force-push; add secrets; re-add WebGL/boot/audio effects; horizontal route enter animations; backdrop-filter on cards without perf review.
